{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999,999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Count of QA orders
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter out QA orders
actual_orders = sales[~qa_mask]

# Count completed orders (excluding QA orders)
completed_count = actual_orders[actual_orders['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Print results
print(f"QA orders found: {qa_count}")
print(f"Actual completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_count}")"}
